description: Page scripts, with or without a layout partial, get onDisconnected and their cleanups when the page is left and a fresh onConnected on every SPA visit, scoped to the page

browserSteps.value: Initial load: the page script connects once and binds its button and a document listener

new Promise((resolve, reject) => { const expected = {boundButtonClicks: 1, documentClicks: 1}; const deadline = performance.now() + 5000; const poll = () => { const record = window.__lifecycle ?? {}; if (Object.entries(expected).every(([name, value]) => record[name] === value)) { resolve(true); return; } if (performance.now() > deadline) { reject(new Error('lifecycle record: expected ' + JSON.stringify(expected) + ', got ' + JSON.stringify(record))); return; } setTimeout(poll, 50); }; poll(); })
SPA navigation away: main disconnects and removes its document listener, other connects despite sharing the layout element

new Promise((resolve, reject) => { const expected = {documentClicks: 1}; const deadline = performance.now() + 5000; const poll = () => { const record = window.__lifecycle ?? {}; if (Object.entries(expected).every(([name, value]) => record[name] === value)) { resolve(true); return; } if (performance.now() > deadline) { reject(new Error('lifecycle record: expected ' + JSON.stringify(expected) + ', got ' + JSON.stringify(record))); return; } setTimeout(poll, 50); }; poll(); })
